Section 17 of the ScheduIe to the Act is amended by repealing subsections ( ) and 〔 2 ) and sub stituting the following n ew subsections therefor " ( ) The Senate shall consist of — 间 ( b ) 463 the Vice ℃ hancellor, who shall be Chairman; the Deputy Vice-ChancelIors, if appointed , the Assistant Vice-ChanceIlors; the heads of institutions; the Dean of Students;

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE 间 the Chief Librarian; the Deputy Deans or deputy heads of institutions; one representative of the full-time professors of each institution, not including visiting professors, elected by the professors of the institution concerned, who shall hold office fo r two years if qualified but who shall be eligible fo r reappointment: Provided that if a professor is already a member of the Senate ex-officio , that professor shall not be eligible to take part in the election of such representative; and such other persons by name or by office as may be prescribed by statute or appointed by the Senate, after consultation with the ViceChanceIIor, to hold office fo r such period as the Senate may determine. 2 ) The Vice-ChanceIIor may appoint a Deputy Vice ℃ hancellor or an Assistant Vice-Chancellor to deputise for him as Chairman at a ny meeting of the Senate if the Vice-Chancellor is unable to attend the meeting: Provided that if no Deputy Vice-ChanceIIor or Assistant Vice-Chancellor is able to attend the meeting, then the Vice-Chancellor m ay appoint a ny member of the Senate to deputise fo r him as Chairman. Substitution of section 32 of ScheduIe.
Section 32 of the ScheduIe to the Act is repealed and the following new section "Publication of statutes and regulations.

《 1 ) When a ny statute or regulation is made, amended or revoked, every such statute or regulation, amendment or revocation shall be published in the University BuIIetin and in such fo rm or in any publication of the University as may be determined by the ViceChancellor. 罔 Nothing in this section shall apply to 间 (b ) any regulation containing only instructions to examiners or invigilators or details concermng courses Of study or syllabi or examinations; any statute or regulation which the Council resolves not to publish.
